notes.text: Now You can drag the App on Setup Wizard Screen
Changed overflow-clip from overflow-hidden in Project Card for Icons to fix clipping bugs in some Mac Devices
Opacity slider in Settings -> Appearance for Icons in Project Cards
PR by Stryde01: Add Chinese translation to the app, Settings -> Display
PR by XRomieo: Add 'Open in Console' option when opening a project
PR by Zalyto: Icon Clipping in Project Card
Tags System: Syncs with Projects' project.godot file
OS Decoration Toggle in Settings -> Display
Open with Console Toggle in Projects Card & Installed Versions
Able to Open Versions themselves in Versions view
Directory Naming Convention
Redesigned Create Project Modal & Clone Project Modal with Live preview
Templates Asset Library to download templates from Godot Asset Store
PR by XRomieo: Workspace scan & refresh now work reliably across workspaces, including newly created ones
Corner radius shape is now a Squircle (iOS styled) for a softer look
Experimental 'New UI' toggle in Settings -> Appearance (beta, disabled for now, will be enabled in a future update)
Create Project button on template cards to start a project from a template right in the Templates view
Known Issues section in the changelog so each version can list its known problems
Fixed 'Template not found' error that could happen after rescanning templates; broken template registrations now self-heal automatically
Custom titlebar is back as the default on Linux, and the OS Decoration toggle in Settings now actually takes effect on Linux too
Known issues in the changelog are now included in the auto-generated GitHub release notes

known_issues: Linux OS: AppImage won't work in some Distros (issue is still unknown and might be a tuari issue, will fix it asap when i find the solution, in the meantime use .rpm or .deb files)
Linux OS: 'Open with Console', 'Open Folder' and 'Open in IDE' might not work in some Distros as well. (issue is still unknown and might be a tuari issue, will fix it asap when i find the solution)
